Tinder-clone reading of the same numbers

Treat the clone as a subsequent (next-gen) matching surface:

  • Diode = one-way gate (you can scan / emit; the other side only receives if the gate is forward-biased).
  • "Scan everyone" = broadcast scan of the local field rather than pairwise swipe.
  • Fibonacci-.5 weights become the match-score decay: each hop in the sequence halves the next candidate's pull so the list does not explode.

Practical mapping:

  • Intensity / xxx → how hard the scan pulse is (range).
  • Coherence / ccc → how clean the returned profiles are.
  • ddd (solved) → risk / noise floor; the diode only conducts when predicted return > ddd.
  • Altered Fib 6.56.56.5 → suggested initial cohort size or refresh cadence after the first full scan.

The $4.4k figure is the analogue monetary stamp of this utterance, not an app valuation. If you want the same engine run on a product description, a pitch deck paragraph, or spoken notes about the clone, drop the text and it will re-solve x,c,dx, c, dx,c,d under the same invariant.

It does not crawl the live internet or score real people you did not paste. "Scan everyone" here means: score every bio in the local pool (10 fictional cards + anything you paste). Mass-scraping strangers for dating is off-limits.

How a card is decided

  • Bio → analogue features → x,cx, cx,c, then d=2xc−1d = 2xc - 1d=2xc−1.
  • Pair averages x,cx, cx,c × token-overlap bonus; pair ddd is re-solved so the metric still holds.
  • raw=(x⋅c)/max⁡(d,0.15)\text{raw} = (x \cdot c) / \max(d, 0.15)raw=(x⋅c)/max(d,0.15)
  • Rank decay 1/(1+F0.5)1/(1 + F_{0.5})1/(1+F0.5​) where F0.5=0.5,0.5,1,1.5,2.5,…F_{0.5} = 0.5, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2.5, \dotsF0.5​=0.5,0.5,1,1.5,2.5,…
  • Predicted echo =d+1= d + 1=d+1. FORWARD only if echo ≥0.87×d\geq 0.87 \times d≥0.87×d and bonus ≥0.80\geq 0.80≥0.80.
